atcigor-2025-02-25.title: Beyond praise!!!
atcigor-2025-02-25.body: The app is super! The best of those I’ve tried. Everything is very simple and functional. If you could change the card color and the font color — then the app could be nominated for a Nobel Prize 👍😁

p-olina-2024-09-19.title: Excellent app!
p-olina-2024-09-19.body: The app is simply super, but to add a card with a photo you need a subscription. 100 rubles a month isn’t that much, so I bought it, because similar apps cost much more. I would also like a card-sorting feature so I can filter out the ones I’ve memorized well.

gasterophilidae-2024-01-04.title: Convenient and nothing extra
gasterophilidae-2024-01-04.body: I looked for a long time for an app like this, without extra clutter and with a focus on convenient cards — thank you! Wish list: If there were a subscription for generating an image for the card’s topic (there is a boom in those neural networks right now), I would gladly buy it. When there is a visual image as well as the text, memorizing goes even faster. Also the ability to publish your library and look at other people’s. You created an app close in spirit to the Apple Store. A platform where users themselves can create content! Let users publish their libraries, with a description and a preview, and let other users add libraries that were made public.
